question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

The plane landed **in the airport. **
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct preposition to use when referring to a plane landing at an airport is "**at**." This ensures proper grammatical usage and clarity.
 
• Options like "**to**", "**into**", and "**towards**" are incorrect in this context because they do not align with how the preposition is used for a location.
